Do's and Don'ts

Do

  • Write each section headline as a finding computed from the data.
  • Colour channel names in their channel text colour.
  • Recompute rates and cost-per metrics from counts after filtering.
  • Give every metric a definition popover matching metrics.md.
  • Keep interactive targets at 44px or larger.
  • Show "Not recorded" for missing costs.

Don't

  • Use Inter, Geist, Bricolage Grotesque or Space Grotesk.
  • Wrap sections in cards or use coloured left-border cards.
  • Use gradients, glassmorphism or glow shadows.
  • Use the accent as a channel colour.
  • Add a second y-axis, pie charts or ring gauges.
  • Use bounce easing or looping animation.
